values.meaning: heal from consuming 9 stacks of Essence Fragment
heal from champion takedown within 3 seconds of damaging them

mechanics.claim: Ahri generates a stack of Essence Fragment whenever she kills a minion or monster, consumed at 9 stacks for a heal.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Essence Fragment'' whenever she kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to {{tip|heal}} herself

mechanics.claim: The champion-takedown heal triggers on a takedown within 3 seconds of damaging the target, separately from the stack-based heal.
mechanics.quote: whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself
